defs.def: no longer alive 死的；失去生命的；枯萎的

ex.s: The noise from the LRAD is directed like a ray of light and travels only into the ears of that person, but it is not deadly.
ex.t: 它发出震耳欲聋的声音，痛苦到足以暂时使人丧失行动能力。

defs.def: no longer believed in or aimed for 不再有人相信（或争取）
belonging to the past; no longer practised or fashionable 过时的；已废弃的；不流行的
finished; not able to be used any more 用完了的；不能再用的
not working because of a lack of power 机器或设备
very quiet, without activity or interest 死气沉沉的；无活力的；无趣的
without activity; with nobody buying or selling anything 停滞的；萧条的
extremely tired; not well 筋疲力尽；身体不好
unable to feel because of cold, etc. 身体部位
unable to feel or understand emotions 无动于衷；麻木不仁；无感觉
showing no emotion 尤指嗓音、眼神或脸色
complete or exact 完全的；精确的；全然的
never having been alive 无生命的；非生物的
outside the playing area 界外的
already dead when arriving at hospital 事故受害者或其他病人
very unlikely to be successful; not working when it is delivered 已不可能成功；到货即损；到达时已无用
people who have died 死人；死者

ex.s: The reason for the explosion is not that people have been reproducing like rabbits, but that people have stopped dropping dead like flies.
ex.t: 人口爆炸的原因不是人们像兔子一样繁殖，而是人们不再像苍蝇一样大量死亡。

defs.def: the state of being dead 死

ex.s: Eric weiner’s The Socrates Express: In Search of Life Lessons from Dead Philosophers reawakened my love for philosophy.
ex.t: 埃里克·韦纳的《苏格拉底快车：从已故哲学家那里寻找人生课》重新点燃了我对哲学的热爱。

ex.s: We were stuck in the middle of the lake with a dead motor.
ex.t: 我们被困在湖中央，发动机坏了。

ex.s: It is where dead leaves turn into food for the trees and other forest life.
ex.t: 它们被称为热带雨林是有原因的！

ex.s: MrsStanley talked mostly about her dead husband, "Mr Stanley and I went shopping this morning." she'd say.
ex.t: 斯坦利太太主要谈论她已故的丈夫，"斯坦利先生和我今天早上一起去购物了。"她会这样说。

ex.s: For the machine, this quality is not in-born, nor is it something introduced by humans; it is a logical consequence of the simple fact that the machine cannot achieve its original purpose if it is dead.
ex.t: 有人认为人类和机器只要团队合作就可以共存——但这只有在机器与人类共享目标的前提下才有可能。

defs.def: completely; exactly 完全地；全然地；确实地

ex.s: It was an area where fishermen were finning, and the sea floor was covered with dead sharks.
ex.t: 那是一个渔民割鱼鳍的地方，海底布满了死鲨鱼。

ex.s: Prince Hamlet is called upon by the supernatural to take revenge upon his uncle, Claudius, who has murdered his brother the king, seized the throne and married the dead king's widow in unseemly haste.
ex.t: 哈姆雷特王子被超自然力量召唤，要向他的叔叔克劳狄斯复仇，克劳狄斯谋杀了他的国王哥哥，篡夺了王位，又以不得体的匆忙娶了已故国王的遗孀。

ex.s: More than 25 million years old, the Great Barrier Reef is made up of living coral growing on dead coral.
ex.t: 大堡礁已有超过两千五百万年的历史，由活珊瑚在死珊瑚上生长而成。

ex.s: Shackleton and his men had crossed the Weddell Sea in the Endurance, but doing so in a small boat was considered deadly.
ex.t: 沙克尔顿和他的同伴们乘坚忍号穿越了威德尔海，但用小船这样做被认为是致命的。

ex.s: The brave men, living and dead, who struggled here, have consecrated it far above our poor power to add or detract.
ex.t: 在这里奋斗过的勇士们，无论生死，已经使这片土地神圣化，远超我们微薄的力量所能增添或减损。

defs.def: very; extremely 非常；绝对；极度
